content_ta: Intuit நிறுவனத்தின் Chairman மற்றும் CEO-வான Sasan Goodarzi, வருவாய் குறித்த கூட்டத்தில் பேசுகையில், செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு கருவிகள் கண்டுபிடிப்புகளுக்கான புதிய நுழைவாயில்களாக மாறி வருவதாகத் தெரிவித்தார். வாடிக்கையாளர்கள் தாங்கள் விரும்பும் இடங்களில் வேலை செய்ய அனுமதிப்பதே நிறுவனத்தின் முக்கிய வியூகமாகும் என்று அவர் குறிப்பிட்டார்.

title: FDIC Proposal Details How Banks Can Pay FinTechs in Deposit Deals
summary:
The Federal Deposit Insurance Corp.’s Nov. 17 proposal implements a provision of the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act that lets eligible banks exclude certain custodial deposits from their brokered deposit totals. content: The Federal Deposit Insurance Corp. has released a proposal that outlines how banks can classify certain custodial deposits under a housing act provision. title: VanEck drops Gemini as custodian of its bitcoin, ether and SOL ETFs
summary: Coinbase Custody will continue serving all three funds after Gemini's contracts end in February.
content: VanEck has dropped Gemini as the custodian for its bitcoin, ether, and SOL exchange-traded funds. Following the termination of these contracts in February, Coinbase Custody will step in to manage all three funds moving forward. This change impacts the custody arrangements for these specific digital asset investment products offered by VanEck.
content_ta: VanEck தனது bitcoin, ether மற்றும் SOL ETF-களுக்கான காவாவாளராக (custodian) செயல்பட்ட Gemini நிறுவனத்துடனான ஒப்பந்தத்தை ரத்து செய்துள்ளது. பிப்ரவரி மாதத்துடன் இந்த ஒப்பந்தங்கள் முடிவுக்கு வரும் நிலையில், Coinbase Custody நிறுவனம் இந்த மூன்று நிதிகளையும் தொடர்ந்து நிர்வகிக்கும் என்று அறிவிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Bitcoin hits four-month low after Anthropic's IPO as tech stocks wilt
summary: Bitcoin remains under pressure after Anthropic's IPO as Nasdaq futures dip below their 200-day average.
content: Bitcoin dropped to a four-month low following Anthropic's initial public offering. The leading cryptocurrency faced renewed downward pressure as broader technology stocks weakened and Nasdaq futures dipped below their crucial 200-day average, reflecting a cautious market sentiment.
content_ta: Anthropic-ன் IPO வெளியீட்டைத் தொடர்ந்து Bitcoin நான்கு மாதக் குறைந்தபட்ச சரிவைச் சந்தித்தது. தொழில்நுட்பப் பங்குகள் பலவீனமடைந்ததாலும், Nasdaq ஃபியூச்சர்ஸ் அதன் முக்கிய 200 நாள் சராசரிக்குக் கீழே குறைந்ததாலும் முன்னணி கிரிப்டோகரன்சி கடுமையான அழுத்தத்தை எதிர்கொண்டது.

title: Institutions pile back into US Bitcoin ETFs in Q3 after selling streak
summary: Asset managers added the equivalent of 49,229 Bitcoin to their US Bitcoin ETF holdings in the third quarter, reversing three quarters of net selling.
content: Institutional asset managers significantly increased their exposure to US Bitcoin ETFs during the third quarter. After experiencing three consecutive quarters of net selling, these large financial institutions added a substantial amount of Bitcoin to their holdings, signaling a renewed interest in the digital asset market through regulated exchange-traded funds.
content_ta: மூன்றாவது காலாண்டில் நிறுவன முதலீட்டாளர்கள் US Bitcoin ETF-களில் தங்கள் முதலீட்டை மீண்டும் அதிகரித்துள்ளனர். தொடர்ந்து மூன்று காலாண்டுகளாக விற்பனையில் ஈடுபட்டு வந்த இந்த பெரிய நிதி நிறுவனங்கள், தற்போது குறிப்பிடத்தக்க அளவில் Bitcoin-ஐ தங்கள் holdings-ல் சேர்த்துள்ளன, இது ஒழுங்குபடுத்தப்பட்ட exchange-traded funds மூலம் டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து சந்தை மீதான புதிய ஆர்வத்தைக் குறிக்கிறது.

title: Coinbase backs CFTC proposal to distinguish prediction market contracts from gambling
summary: Coinbase said event contracts already qualify as swaps under the CEA and that explicit inclusion would provide greater regulatory certainty.
content: Cryptocurrency exchange Coinbase has voiced support for a proposal by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission regarding prediction market contracts. Coinbase stated that these event contracts already qualify as swaps under the Commodity Exchange Act. The company believes that explicit regulatory inclusion would provide much-needed certainty for the market.
content_ta: கிரிப்டோகரன்சி எக்ஸ்சேஞ்ச் ஆன Coinbase, CFTC-ன் கணிப்பு சந்தை ஒப்பந்தங்கள் தொடர்பான பரிந்துெரைக்கு தனது ஆதரவைத் தெரிவித்துள்ளது. இந்த நிகழ்வு ஒப்பந்தங்கள் ஏற்கனவே Commodity Exchange Act-ன் கீழ் ஸ்வாப்களாகத் தகுதிபெறுகின்றன என்று Coinbase கூறியது. தெளிவான ஒழுங்குமுறைச் சேர்க்கை சந்தைக்குத் தேவையான நிச்சயத்தன்மையை வழங்கும் என்று நிறுவனம் நம்புகிறது.

Tether நிறுவனம் தங்கத்தின் இருப்பை அதிகரிப்பதிலும் பொதுப் பங்குகளில் முதலீடு செய்வதன் மூலமும் தனது போர்ட்ஃபோலியோவை விரிவுபடுத்தியுள்ள போதிலும், இதுபோன்ற உயர்-ரிஸ்க் சொத்துக்களின் அதிகரிப்பு கவலைக்குரியது என்று ஆய்வாளர்கள் எச்சரிக்கின்றனர்.

title: This Bitcoin miner sold 267 BTC to clear $22 million debt. It still may not survive
summary: PowerCompute had its lender sell 267 pledged bitcoin in September, wiping out most of its debt, and ended the month with about $650,000 in cash and a going-concern warning.
content: Bitcoin miner PowerCompute sold 267 pledged BTC in September to clear $22 million in debt. Despite wiping out most of its financial liabilities, the company ended the month with only about $650,000 in cash and still faces a serious going-concern warning, raising doubts about whether it will ultimately survive.
content_ta: Bitcoin miner PowerCompute, செப்டம்பர் மாதத்தில் தனது $22 மில்லியன் கடனை அடைப்பதற்காக 267 pledged BTC-ஐ விற்றது. இதன் மூலம் தனது பெரும்பாலான கடன் சுமையை தீர்த்த போதிலும், அந்த மாதத்தின் இறுதியில் நிறுவனத்திடம் சுமார் $650,000 ரொக்கம் மட்டுமே இருந்தது. மேலும், இது நிறுவனம் தொடர்ந்து இயங்குவதில் சந்தேகம் எழுப்பும் வகையில் ஒரு going-concern எச்சரிக்கையையும் எதிர்கொண்டுள்ளது.

title: Big money bought a net $4 billion of bitcoin funds in Q3, ending 9 months of selling

title: Cardano’s $5M conference budget has a $1M problem — Details!

title: Float Announces $5M Investment in Québec, With Commitment to a Montréal Office and Local Hiring

Float Financial (Float), Canada’s intelligent financial operating system, today announced a $5 million investment in Québec, its first in the province.

That’s why we’re excited to be on the ground in Montréal, building alongside them.”
Float Intelligence, the platform’s AI layer, automates the workflows finance teams run every day so they can spend less time on manual finance work, including receipt chasing, data entry and reconciliation. Québec businesses will also get corporate cards in CAD and USD, high-yield accounts, bill pay, working capital credit and cross-border payments through Float’s integrated platform.

From corporate cards and reimbursements to fraud protection and earning interest on our cash, Float makes financial management simple, secure, and agile. That means less time spent on administration and more resources dedicated to what matters most: bringing life-changing medical technology to patients."
Float already offers an integrated experience in both official languages and supports Québec’s GST and QST requirements. With this investment, Float is offering Québec businesses one year of its Pro plan at no cost, a higher cashback rate and a market-leading rate of up to 3.75% interest on funds held in Float.

title: SoFi Study Reveals How Crypto Is Becoming Part of the Bigger Financial Picture
summary:
SoFi Technologies, Inc., the everything app for digital financial services, today released “From Side Quest to Financial Strategy,” a national report exploring the growing role of crypto in people's financial lives. Gen Z is leading the shift, with nearly two-thirds seeing crypto as a financial opportunity previous generations didn't have. 21% own cryptocurrency, seven times the rate of Boomers. The findings also challenge long-held investor stereotypes and highlight interest in managing crypto alongside everyday banking and investing.
“Gen Z has come of age in a world where money is already digital, so it’s natural that they’re pushing the boundaries of the traditional, one-size-fits-all approach to building wealth,” said Natalie Brunell, host of Coin Stories, author of Bitcoin Is for Everyone and contributor to SoFi’s On The Block. “What people are asking for now is not just access to new tools, but the education and connected experience to understand how they fit together and support their broader financial goals.”
The value of having your finances connected goes beyond convenience. As people explore new ways to manage and build wealth, keeping track of their money matters more than ever. In fact, more than one in five respondents estimate they've lost or missed out on $1,000 or more over the past year because their finances are spread across multiple platforms.
“People have more opportunities than ever to grow their money, and digital assets are opening new possibilities for how they invest and build wealth,” said Brian Walsh, CFP®, PhD and Head of Advice & Planning at SoFi. “But having more financial options is only valuable if you can make the most of them. At SoFi, we're bringing banking, investing and crypto together so members can see their full financial picture, explore new opportunities with confidence and make smarter money moves to achieve their ambitions.”
The trends shaping the next era of money:
The future of money is connected. Nearly two-thirds (63%) of crypto investors say integrating crypto with their primary bank would make them more likely to invest more. Among Gen Z, 43% say bank integration would make them more likely to invest, compared with 9% of Boomers.
Gen Z is rewriting the wealth-building playbook. More than one in five (21%) see crypto as a path to generational wealth, compared with just 8% of the general population. Gen Z is also more likely to own crypto (21%) than an employer-sponsored retirement plan (16%), and represents nearly one-third (31%) of SoFi’s crypto members.
Crypto curiosity is opening the door to new investors. More than half of Americans (52%) say they should know more about crypto, including 63% of Gen Z. Even among current crypto investors, 82% say there's more they want to learn.
Debunking the 'Tech Bro' Myth. Nearly one-third of Gen Z discuss crypto often or sometimes in daily life (31%). Black and Hispanic respondents are more than twice as likely (22%) as White respondents (9%) to own it, while women are nearly as likely as men to be crypto-curious (12% vs. 13%).
America's crypto landscape is anything but one-size-fits-all. Miami leads the 10 cities surveyed in crypto ownership (20%), while New York City outpaces tech hub San Francisco (17% vs. 13%). Kansas City sits at the other end of the spectrum, with just 5% invested.
SoFi members are already bringing crypto into their broader financial lives. Nearly all SoFi Crypto members (97%) also use another SoFi product, including SoFi Money checking or savings accounts (85%) and SoFi Invest (64%). “I’ve started moving my outside crypto holdings into SoFi because having my accounts together in one place makes managing my finances easier,” said a SoFi member.
One year after becoming the first nationally chartered bank to launch crypto trading, SoFi continues to bring the best of banking and crypto together in one app. Members can buy, sell and hold more than 40 cryptocurrencies alongside banking and investing. SoFi Earn (SOFIE) deposit token offers 4.40% APY on eligible FDIC-insured deposits, while SoFiUSD stablecoin enables 24/7 on-chain transactions. Together, these innovations make digital assets part of members’ broader financial lives, with the trust and safeguards of a bank.
